sections.title: The First Vision

verses.text: In the year of the desolation of our city Jerusalem, which is called the thirtieth year, I, Suteuel, was in Babylon; and in my sleep, I was troubled; my face was revealed. In my heart, I was filled with sorrow and lamentation.
I cannot rejoice in the destruction of Zion, nor in the joy of those who dwell in Babylon.
My body was weary; I began to speak of fearful things with the Most High.
And I spoke, saying, "O Lord, my God, is it not true that when You created the earth, You alone were there? Is it not true that You commanded the earth to be formed by placing Adam in the flesh?"
He is the work of Your hands; in Him, You breathed the breath of life; before You, He became a living being.
And the earth did not tremble, but Your right hand led him to the garden of Eden.
And You commanded him the command of righteousness; Your command he forsook; and thereafter, upon him and his children, You brought death; nations and peoples, those without number, were born of him.
And all nations dwelt according to their works. Before You, they were guilty; yet You did not forsake them.
And in due time, You brought forth the waters of destruction upon the earth and upon the inhabitants of this world; You destroyed them.
Their punishment was mingled; as You brought death upon Adam, so also did You bring the waters of destruction upon these.
And among them was a man named Noah, whom thou didst associate with his household; and from him were born the righteous and the wicked.

"And after this, they shall multiply, and those who dwell upon the earth shall be as numerous as the stars in the heavens; and their children shall be many, and they shall be a great multitude of nations and peoples at the time of their birth; and they shall greatly increase, even more than those who were before them."
"And after this, before thee, in the time of wickedness, choose one of them, whom thou shalt call Abraham."
"And him thou lovedst; and the end of the age was shown to him alone in the night."

"Thou didst establish the covenant of the world with him; and thou didst give him hope that his children should not be destroyed until the end of the world. Thou didst also give him Isaac; and to Isaac thou didst give Jacob and Esau. And Jacob thou didst give to himself, but Esau was thy enemy; and Jacob became a great nation."
"And when thou didst bring forth his seed from Egypt, thou didst lead them to Mount Sinai."

"Thou didst lower the heavens for them; and thou didst shake the earth for them; and thou didst make the world tremble for them; and thou didst shake the deep for them; and thou didst part the sea for them."

"To the children of Jacob thou didst give the law, and to the tribes of Israel thou didst give commandments, that they might be as four signs of thy greatness: the fire and the cloud, the hail and the wind."
"But concerning them, the fruit of thy law shall be done, that thou mayest not turn away from them evil thoughts. For the first Adam had a wicked heart and was led astray."
"He alone is not; for all the children born of him are."
And after this, that heart was with all men in accordance with Thy law, and it dwelt with evil deeds; yet it perished in goodness; but wickedness remained.
The time passed; the year was fulfilled; Thy servant, whose name is David, Thou didst raise up.
For Thy name shall build Thy city, and Thy glory shall be offered within her.
For many years have passed; yet there are none that do good works in this world, and those who dwell therein are in sin.
As Adam did, so did all his children; they too have committed evil thoughts and have made them as treasures.
And He delivered Thy city into the hand of Thy enemies.

sections.title: Babylon hath been as one that is desolate with Zion.

verses.text: At that time, I wondered in my heart whether the inhabitants of Babylon, who dwell there, would truly be righteous in their deeds for the sake of the city of Zion. I said, "No."
And after this, when I came to this place, I beheld a sin that had no number; behold, for thirty years my body had seen many afflictions; and thus my heart was troubled.
How do You protect the righteous, and how do You guide the wicked? I beheld how You keep watch over Your kin and guard against their enemies.
You have not regarded anyone; what is the end of this path? Is there not a place where righteousness is performed, that Babylon may not surpass Zion?
Indeed, is there not another people besides Israel that You know? Or is there another people that has trusted in You like Jacob according to Your law?

Is there not a price that has not been revealed, and is there not a poor one that You do not regard? And when I went to the nations, they rejoiced at Your law and Your commandments without consideration.
Even now, let there be found among us a weighty sin, as it is with those who dwell in Babylon, that our transgressions may be weighed in the balance.
When will there be those who dwell in this world that have not been ashamed before You? Or is there a people that has kept Your law in such a manner?
A perfect people cannot be found.

sections.title: The mind of man is his essence.

verses.text: ስሙ ዑርኤል የተባለው ወደ እኔ የተላከው መልአክ መለሰልኝ።
“የልዑልን የጌትነቱን ምክር ታገኝ ዘንድ ልቡናህ ማድነቅን አደነቀን?” አለኝ።
“አዎ ጌታዬ፥” አልሁት፤ እርሱም እንዲህ አለኝ፥ “ሦስቱን መንገዶች አሳይህ ዘንድ፥ ሦስቱንም ምሳሌዎች በፊትህ አኖር ዘንድ ተላክሁ፥
ከእነዚህም አንዲቱን የተረጐምህልኝ እንደ ሆነ እኔም ታውቅ ዘንድ የምትወዳትን ይህችን መንገድ እነግርሃለሁ፤ ይህ ክፉ ልቡናም ስለምን እንደ ሆነ አስተምርሃለሁ።”
እኔም አልሁት፥ “አቤቱ ተናገር” እርሱም አለኝ፥ “እሳቱን በሚዛን መዝን፤ ነፋሱንም በመስፈሪያ ስፈር፤ ያለፈችውንም ቀን ጥራት።”
እኔም መልሼ እንዲህ አልሁት፥ “ስለዚህ ነገር እኔን እንደ ጠየቅኸኝ ይህን ነገር ማድረግ የሚችል የተፈጠረ ሰው ማን ነው?”
እርሱም አለኝ፥ “በባሕር ውስጥ ምን ያህል ቤቶች አሉ? ወይም በጥልቁ ውስጥ ምን ያህል ምንጮች አሉ? ወይም በሰማያት ላይ ምን ያህል መንገድ አለ? ወይም የሲኦል መንገድ በየት ነው? ወይም የገነት መንገድ በየት ነው? ብዬ ጠይቄህስ ቢሆን፥
ወደ ጥልቁ አልወረድሁም፤ ወደ ሲኦልም ፈጽሜ አልወረድሁም፤ ወደ ሰማይም አልወጣሁም ባልኸኝ ነበር።
አሁን ግን ስለ ነፋስና ስለ እሳት፥ ስላለፈችውም ቀን እንጂ ይህን አልጠየቅሁህም፤ እነሆ፥ ልታውቀው አትችልም፤ ስለ እነዚህም የመለስህልኝ የለም።
በአንተ ዘንድ ያለውን ማወቅ ያልቻልህ፥

How canst thou know the way of the Most High? The way of the Most High hath been taken without completion; thou who art fearful, thou who art troubled, thou canst not know the way of the Most High, which is neither fearful nor troubled.

And when I heard this, I fell upon my face; and I said, "It would have been better for us to have been created in sin and to have endured suffering than to have been created without suffering; for we know not how to endure suffering."

sections.title: The Parable of the Trees and the Sea

verses.text: And he answered me, saying, "The trees and the forest have gone and taken counsel."
"Let us flee from before our face and go to the sea; for our trees, let us seek another land," they said.
Likewise, the inhabitants of the sea took counsel, saying, "For our habitation, let us seek another land, and let us go to the wilderness where there is a tree."
The counsel of the trees was in vain; for fire shall consume them.
Likewise, the counsel of the inhabitants of the sea was in vain; for the storm has swept them away.
"If you know judgment, of these whom do you declare to be true, and whom do you declare to be false?" he said to me.
And I answered him, saying, "Both thought in vain; the tree is for the forest, and the sea bears the burden of the habitation."
And he answered me, saying: "Your horse is good; why then do you not ride for yourself?"

As the tree is given for the forest, and the sea for its habitation, so also the inhabitants of the earth can know what is on the earth, but that which is in the heavens and above the heavens is not known.

sections.title: The fulfillment of the age.

verses.text: And I said, "O Lord, I beseech Thee; why has a heart been given unto us to think upon evil?"

But I, I do not desire to seek the way of the righteous; for it is always said concerning us, that Israel is given over to destruction, and the people whom Thou lovest is delivered unto sinners; for the heritage of our fathers is lost, and the covenant written within it is no more.
We are as a fleeting shadow upon the earth; our lives are as a passing breath; and we are not worthy to receive mercy.
Yet, concerning us, since we are called by Thy holy name, what shall we do? Therefore, I have asked Thee.
And He answered me, saying, "If thou art in life, thou shalt see; and if thou dost live, in due time thou shalt know; for the world shall pass away."
The world cannot contain the hope of the righteous, for this world is filled with sorrow, and it is filled with lamentation.
Concerning her, the sin that I asked of Thee has been multiplied, and her affliction has not reached me.
Within her, if the sin that has been sown does not perish and does not rise, the place where it has been sown shall not be removed.

In the beginning, the evil seed was sown in the heart of Adam, and the fruit of sin was born, and even unto this day it has been brought forth; and its affliction shall be born until it comes to pass.
Consider thyself! If the evil seed be sown, this much of the fruit of sin has been born.
"The seed of the righteous is indeed good, but how shall it bear good fruit if it is sown without number?"
And I said, "How long shall the righteous endure? For the times of this world are evil, and they are few."
And he answered me, saying, "You are not one who is greatly troubled compared to the Most High; you grieve for yourself, but the Most High grieves for many."
Therefore, the souls of the righteous in their dwelling place asked, "Until when shall we dwell here? When shall our worth be made known?"
The angel replied to them, saying, "The number of the righteous like you shall be made known at the appointed time."
This world has been weighed in the balance, and the sea has been set as a measure; the decree given shall remain until it is fulfilled; it shall not awaken nor be disturbed."
And I answered, saying, "O Lord, behold, we are all enveloped in sin;"
"Perhaps the worth of the righteous shall be delayed because of us? Or is it due to the sins of those who dwell in this world?"
And he also answered me, saying, "After nine months have passed, it shall be that she who is pregnant shall give birth to her child; go and inquire of the woman who has conceived."
And I answered, saying, "O Lord, it cannot be," and he said to me, "So shall be the dwelling places of Sheol and the souls of the righteous."
As a woman in labor experiences pain to give birth, so too does the earth, from the moment of its creation, groan to deliver those who have been received.
At that time, I shall speak unto you concerning that which you love.

sections.title: How long shall the time remain?

verses.text: እኔም መለስሁለት እንዲህም አልሁት፥ “በፊትህ ባለሟልነትን ካገኘሁ፥ ልጠይቅም እንዲቻለኝ ካደረግኸኝ ይኽን ንገረኝ።
ይመጣ ዘንድ ያለው ዘመን ባለፈው ዘመን ልክ ነውን? ወይስ ያለፈው ዘመን ይበዛል?
ያለፈውን አውቀዋለሁና፥ የሚመጣውን ግን አላውቀውምና።”
እርሱም አለኝ፥ “በቀኝ በኩል ባንድ ወገን ሁነህ ቁም፤ የምሳሌውንም ትርጓሜ አሳይሀለሁ።”
እኔም ቆምሁ፤ እነሆም ምድጃ በፊቴ እየነደደ ሲሄድ አየሁ፤ ከዚህም በኋላ እሳቱ በሄደ ጊዜ እነሆ ጢሱ ቀረ።
ከእርሱም በኋላ ውኃን የተመላች ደመና በፊቴ ሄደች፤ ታላቅና ብዙ የሆነ ዝናምንም ታዘንማለች፤ ታላቁ ዝናምም ካለፈ በኋላ ካፊያው ቀረ።
እርሱም አለኝ፥ “እንግዲህ እስኪ አንተ ዐስበው፤ ከካፊያው ዝናሙ፥ ከጢሱ እሳቱ እንደሚበዛ፥ እንደዚሁም ያለፈው መስፈርት ይበዛል፤ ነገር ግን ካፊያውም ጢሱም ይቀራል።
“እስከ እነዚያ ዘመኖች ድረስ እኖራለሁን? እንጃ! በእነዚያስ ወራቶች ምን ይደረጋል?” ብዬ ማለድሁት።
እርሱም መለሰልኝ እንዲህም አለኝ፥ “ስለ ጠየቅኸኝ ምልክትስ ከብዙ በጥቂቱ መንገር ይቻለኛል፤ ስለ ሕይወትህ ግን እነግርህ ዘንድ አልተላክሁም፤ እኔም አላውቀውም።

sections.title: The sign of the end of the world.

verses.text: "And behold, the sign shall come; the time shall draw near; a great calamity shall seize those who dwell upon the earth; the way of righteousness shall be forsaken; and faith shall perish from the land."
"In sin, thou art more abundant than in what thou hast seen and heard."
"Today, that which is lost and that which is scattered shall be seen to perish; the earth shall become a wilderness."

"After He hath given thee life for three months, when thou dost look upon the earth, thou shalt behold it desolate; the sun shall strike like a hammer by night; and the moon shall strike like a hammer by day."
"From the trees shall flow blood; the stones shall cry out; the people shall be called; and the beasts shall be scattered."
"Many shall be those who have not been spared."
"All shall hear His word."
"In many nations, there shall be oppression; great fire shall be sent forth; and the wild beasts of the wilderness shall seek their places. Among women, there shall be a sign of travail."
"The water that is to be poured out shall be bitter; and friends shall contend against one another like enemies; at that time, wisdom shall be forsaken; and counsel shall return to its dwelling."
"Many shall seek to find it; yet they shall not obtain it; for upon the earth, sin, iniquity, and transgression shall abound."
"Is there a righteous deed done in truth in your land, or is there a man who does righteousness?" Thus she inquires. And she replies, "There is none."
In those days, a man longs for death; yet he does not find it; his wife is taken from him; he does not rejoice; he is distressed; and his work he continues to do; yet his way does not prosper.
"This shall be a sign to you: today, as you fast, if you pray for seven days and if you humble yourself, you shall hear more than this."
And I awoke from my sleep; my body was exceedingly weary; my body was distressed until I was exhausted.
And the angel who came to me and spoke to me touched my hand; and he said, "Stand upon your feet."
After this, on the second night, the leader of the people came to me and said, "Where have you been? Why have you wept before me?"
Do you not know that all Israel in the land of Mirko is given to you as a gift?
Therefore, do not oppress Israel; and like a lion that tears apart its prey, do not rise up against them; arise and show mercy.
And I said to him, "Depart from me; until the seventh day, do not come to me; after this, come to me, and I will tell you the matter." And he departed from me.

sections.title: The Second Vision

verses.text: እኔም መልአኩ ዑርኤል እንዳዘዘኝ አዝኜ እያለቀስሁ ሰባት ቀን ጾምሁ።
ከሰባት ቀን በኋላም የልቡናዬ አሳብ እጅግ አደከመኝ።
የጥበብም መንፈስ ሰውነቴን አነሣሣቻት፤ ዳግመኛም በልዑል ፊት እናገር ጀመርሁ።
እንዲህም አልሁ፥ “አቤቱ ጌታዬ፥ ከምድር ዛፎችና እንጨቶች ሁሉ አንድ የወይን ሐረግን ለአንተ መረጥህ።
ከዓለሙ ጥልቆች ሁሉ አንድ ወንዝን ለአንተ መላህ።
ከሀገሮችም ሁሉ አንድ ሀገርን መረጥህ፤ ከተሠሩት ከተሞችም ሁሉ ጽዮንን ለአንተ ቀደስህ።
ከተፈጠሩ ወፎችም ሁሉ አንድ ርግብን ለአንተ ለየህ፤ ከተፈጠሩት እንስሳትም ሁሉ አንድ በግን መረጥህ።
ከምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ አንድ ሕዝብን ለራስህ መረጥህ፤ ለዚህ ለመረጥኸው ሕዝብህም በሁሉ ዘንድ የተፈተነ ሕግህን ሰጠኸው።
“አሁንም አቤቱ፥ ይህን አንዱን ለብዙዎች አሳልፈህ ለምን ሰጠኸው? ከሌሎችም ሥሮች ለይተህ አንዱን ሥር ለምን አጐሳቈልኸው? አንድ ሕዝብንስ በብዙዎች መካከል ለምን በተንኸው?
የተስፋህ ባላጋራዎችዋ በሕግህ የታመኑትን ረገጧቸው።
"And it would be better for you to strike them with your hand than to let them be your enemies."
"And after I had spoken this word, on that very night an angel came to me."
"And he said to me, 'Listen to me; I will speak to you, and I will tell you many things.'"
"And I replied, 'Lord, speak.' And he said to me, 'Is this not a great wonder for Israel? Or do you love Israel more than the Creator?'"
"And I answered, 'Lord, it is not so; but I spoke because of my concern for me; Lord, always grant me the way of the righteous, and let me know the search for the lost, for my heart is troubled.'"

"And he said to me, 'You cannot.' And I replied, 'Lord, why is this? Why was I born? Why should I not bear the suffering of Jacob and the weakness of the tribes of Israel? Why should my mother's womb not be a grave?'"
"And he said to me, 'Count the days that have not yet come, and gather the flowers that have withered; and let me see the dust that has settled.'"

"And open the houses that are closed; and bring forth the hidden spirits within them; and show me their faces that I have not seen; and let me hear their words; and at that time I will tell you the suffering that they will endure.'"
"And I answered and said, 'Lord my Master, if I am not different from man, who can know this?'"
"I am a stranger and one who has fallen; how then can I speak to you about what you ask of me?"
And He said to me, “Just as you are unable to speak one word to Me, so you cannot attain the end of My love, which you express for your kin.”
And I said, “O Lord, behold, You are concerned for them; what will You do for those who were before us? And for us and those who will come after us?”
And He said to me, “Do not let those who are behind you be judged, nor let those who have gone before be hastily condemned; I have made you as a covering.”
And I said, “Will You not hasten to show Your judgment, so that those who have gone before and those who are behind, and even those who are present now, cannot be created all at once?”
And I said, “The work of the Creator is not to be hastened; the world was created in its own time, even if they were unable to bear it.”

And I said, “O Lord, how can it be that You will raise them all at once in unity? If You are able to raise them all at once, the world will tremble; and if this is not so, then it would have been possible to carry them all together at once.”
And He said to me, “Until you have borne a woman’s womb, and have given birth to ten children, why do you bear them each year? Behold, I ask you, will you not give the ten at once?”
Is it not that you cannot give birth at once, except in the year?
Just as a woman cannot give birth to a child, nor can she be delivered, so I too have worked in the world according to the order of each time.

And I asked Him; and I said, “Since You have given me a way to speak before You, behold, truly I have not seen You; my mother, who was young, has given birth; why are we not strong like those who have gone before us?”
And He answered me, saying, “Ask the woman who has given birth to a son; she will speak unto you.”
They may be strong in their youth, but why are they not as they were in the days of their birth? Thus spoke she.
And she said, “A child born in youth is indeed strong; but one born in old age is weak and feeble.”
Nevertheless, you shall know that you are stronger than those who have gone before you.
And those who shall be born after you shall be weaker than you; for the strength of infancy shall pass away in its time.”
And I said, “O Lord my God, let it be as You have said; if I find favor in Your sight, tell Your servant, for by whom shall You be glorified in the world?”

And He said unto me, “The first is of man; but afterward, I am Myself; the heavens and the earth, and the nations shall not be created, nor shall the way of the world be established, nor shall the winds blow.”
The voice of the trumpet shall not be heard, nor shall the brightness of the lightning shine, nor shall the land of paradise be created.
The beauty of the fathers shall not be seen, nor shall the power of the earth be established, nor shall the hosts of angels be counted.
The mystery of heaven shall not be revealed, nor shall the standard of the heavens be measured.
The coming world shall not be known, nor shall the curse of the wicked be lifted; the seal of the Lord shall not be broken upon those who keep the law and believe in faith.
At that time, I thought to myself, “I shall visit this world; there is none other.”
And I answered him, saying, “What is the sign of the first world? What is the time of its end? When shall the beginning of the second world be?”
Thus He spoke unto me, “From Abraham to Isaac it is; Jacob and Esau were born of him, and at their birth, Jacob took hold of Esau's heel and was born.”
Esau is a parable of the end of this age; and Jacob is the beginning of the new age.
The end of man is the body that is born; and the beginning of man is his hand. Nevertheless, do not be deceived.”
And I answered him, saying, "O Lord my God, if I have found favor in Your sight,
tell Your servant the end of this sign which You spoke to me last night."
And He answered me, saying, "Arise, stand on your feet; for I will speak to you the word that has come to you."
If the place where you stand within is shaken, do not be afraid at your word; for it is the end of the matter.
At that time, the foundations of the earth will reveal the matter.
The matter is concerning them, for they will be troubled; they will be shaken; and they will not pass away until the end comes."
After this, when I heard this, I arose and stood on my feet; behold, I heard the word that was spoken; and the voice was like the sound of many waters.
To all who dwell on the earth, when the time comes to them, behold, the time will come.
Zion, when it is brought low, will be a cause for lamentation; at that time, I will guide them.
The sign that will occur when the world is brought low is this: it will be revealed in the heavens; all will see it.
The children who are of age shall speak; the women who have given birth shall bear children of three months and four months; and they shall rise up alive.
The land that cannot be seen shall be sown, and within it, the houses that were full shall be found empty.
The sound of the trumpet shall be heard; and all who hear it shall rejoice.

In those days, friends shall contend with their friends as foes; and the earth shall astonish those who dwell therein; the springs of water shall be troubled; and they shall not cease until the third hour.
"From all that I have told you, every man who remains shall be the one who is saved; he shall see my deliverance and the fulfillment of my time."

At that time, they shall be gathered, and those who have not tasted death shall see those men; and those who dwell in the world shall have their hearts turned; and another heart shall be given to them.
Destruction shall be your companion, and calamity shall consume you.
Faith shall be renewed; death shall rise in victory; and the righteousness that has been without fruit for many generations shall be revealed."
When I was spoken to, the place where I stood was small, and it was shifting little by little.
And he said to me, "I have come to speak this sign to you, just as I told you last night."
ዳግመኛ ሰባት ቀን ብትጾምና ብትጸልይ ከዚህ የሚበልጥ ዳግመኛ እነግርሃለሁ።
ቃልህ በልዑል ዘንድ መሰማትን ተሰምትዋልና። ከሕፃንነትህም ጀምሮ ያለው የጽድቅህ ኀይል ተገልጧልና።
ስለዚህም ይህን ነገር እነግርህ ዘንድ ልዑል ላከኝ።
እንዲህም አለኝ፦ እመን፤ አትፍራ፤ በኋላ ዘመን እንዳትጠራጠር ስለ ቀደመውም ክፉ አሳብህ አትቸኩል።”

sections.title: The Third Vision

verses.text: And after this, I shall fast for seven days, as I have been told concerning the three supplications.
On that night, my heart was troubled; I began to speak before the Most High.
My body is weary, and my heart is distressed.
Thus I said, "O Lord my God, in the beginning of Your creation, on the first day, You created the heavens and the earth; and so it was created; Your word was to create all things."
And the Spirit was hovering. Darkness was upon the face of the deep, and silence prevailed; the voice of man had not yet been heard.
At that time, You commanded that light should shine forth from Your dwelling, and that Your creation should be made manifest.
"And on the second day, You created the firmament in the heavens; and let it be divided, so that it may rise above, and let it dwell below, that it may be separated from the waters."

And on the third day, You commanded that the waters be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear; and let the earth bring forth grass, and let it be fruitful, and let it be dry before You.
Your word was that creation should be made manifest.
At that time, there were many fruits without number; the taste of them was delightful, and each had its own appearance; the types of wood were also distinct; and their forms were varied.
"And on the fourth day, let there be lights in the firmament of heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs and for seasons, and for days and years."
"Let them serve as a minister to the man, and let them obey your command."
"And on the fifth day, let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven."
"Therefore, let all generations speak of your lordship, and let that water, which has no soul, bring forth the water of life."
"At that time, you preserved the two creatures you created; one of them was called by its kind, and the other was called by its kind."
"Each according to its own kind; for that fifth hand, which is in the waters, cannot take them."
"The four mountains were there, and He dwelt within them; for one hand of the six was given to the nations."
"And for the fowl of the sea, He gave the seventh hand; and for those who love them, let them be food."
"And on the sixth day, before you, let the creatures, the fowl of the air and the beasts of the field, be brought forth, and command the earth."
"And over all of this, you made Adam a ruler; you appointed him over the creation you made. And by him, we, your chosen people, were found."
"O Lord, I have spoken all these things before Thee; for I have said that Thou hast created this world for us."
"But the other nations descended from Adam are as the imbeciles; they are like the beasts; they are like the wild animals; their joy is as that of the imbeciles."
"Now behold, those nations that are without understanding are as the imbeciles; lo, they have risen against us; they have oppressed us."
"The one whom I love, my beloved son, is not with us; yet we, Thy kin, have fallen into the hands of the nations."
"Yet, concerning the world, why shall we not inherit our world which Thou hast created for us? How long shall this endure?"
And after this, I spoke these words, and in the time of my prayer, the angel that came to me before that night was sent to me.
Thus he said unto me, “O Ezra, arise; hear my words which I speak unto thee.”
And I said unto him, “My Lord, speak;” and he said unto me, “In a broad place there is a sea; and it is wide and deep.”
There is no entrance to the gate; the water of the river is as a flood.
And if there be one who desires to enter into that sea, how can he enter if he has not passed through the gate?
Or there is a city that is built in the plain, and it is filled with all blessings.
And the way to her entrance is a gate; and she is within the wall; on her right is fire, and on her left is deep water.
There is a way between water and fire; and her path cannot be trodden except by the foot of a man.
If there be a man who is given this city as an inheritance, how can he inherit if he has not passed through the way of the gate?
And I said, “O Lord, so it is.” And he said unto me, “The land of Israel, their chance is likewise.”
I have created the world for their sake.
And Adam, when he transgressed My command, the way of this world became a wilderness, and desolation, and the calamity increased, and it became entangled with sorrow.
But that world is great; it is vast; it is bright; it bears the fruit of life where death is not present.
You who are alive, if you do not cast off that desolation and that sin, you will not be able to obtain that which has been prepared for you.
Now, you who are dust, why do you boast? You who are to die, why do you speak arrogantly?
It is what is present that you see; why do you not consider what is to come in your heart?

sections.title: The path of righteousness is a blessed opportunity.

verses.text: And I answered, saying, “O Lord my God, as the righteous inherit this world, the wicked shall perish; behold, speak Thou in Thy law.”
The righteous shall be sustained by their hope, but the wicked who trust in their own strength shall not attain the wide places.
And He said unto me, “Thou art not better than one who is judged by the Lord; thou art not greater than the Most High.”
Those who violate the law of the Lord shall perish;
For the Lord has commanded that they who keep His law shall live. Yet they were not diligent in keeping it.
But the wicked shall fall; they shall be cast away; they have devised evil thoughts for themselves.
They have made money for themselves from the spoil and the plunder; and concerning all these things, the Lord is not with them; they have forsaken their way.
If they forsake the law, they shall not keep their covenant; they shall not trust in the statutes; their work shall cease; they shall not remember their prayers.
Therefore, the forsaken is for the forsaken; and the filled is for the filled.

sections.title: The Kingdom of Messiah

verses.text: "Behold, I have spoken to you a sign, and it shall come to pass; today the city that you see shall be laid waste; today the land that has been forsaken shall be revealed."
"He is the one who sees my glory, for I have delivered you from all evil deeds."
"My mercy shall be revealed to those who are with me, and it shall bring joy to those who rise up."
"After this, my son shall fulfill his mission; and every man who has understanding shall fulfill it."
"And the world shall return to its former state, as in the days of old, when it was silent for seven days; nothing shall remain."
"And after the seventh day, there shall be no one who does not awaken; the world shall not pass away."
"The earth shall return to those who have received it; and the land shall restore those who have been buried within it; and thereafter, the souls that have dwelt within them shall be restored."
"At that time, the exalted shall be revealed upon His throne; His grace shall come forth; His mercy shall return; and His faithfulness shall be gathered."
"Only a righteous judgment shall remain; justice shall prevail; and faith shall be revealed."
"A man shall be followed by his work; and his worth shall be revealed; his integrity shall awaken; and his sin shall not be hidden."
The judgment of the wicked shall be revealed in a place of rest. In joy, the paradise shall be shown, and in sorrow, the fire of hell shall be revealed.

"At that time, the Most High shall say to the nations that have risen from the dead: 'Behold, who are those that you have brought forth? Know who has not been redeemed; to whom do you belong? Whose command have you obeyed?'"
Behold, before you is a place of joy and rest; there is also judgment and fire.
"The Most High shall say to the nations on the day of judgment: 'This is the day of judgment; there shall be no sun, nor moon, nor stars.'"
Clouds, lightning, thunder, winds, water, heaven, darkness, night, and the seasons shall not be present;
Winter, summer, spring, autumn, heat, cold, strong winds, rain, hail, snow, and frost shall not be found.
Night and day, brightness and radiance, the sun and the light, all that is reserved for Him shall not be present, except for the glory of God.
The length of that hour shall be as seven years.
"This is the judgment, and this is the punishment; I declare this only to you."

sections.title: Concerning the little ones who are in need.

verses.text: And I said, "Now, O Lord, those who dwell in accordance with Thy command are indeed the righteous."
Yet, concerning my inquiry, who among the living is unworthy? Who is it that has not been born of the lineage of Thy law?
Even now, in the world to come, I do not believe that there are but a few righteous, while many shall be condemned.

Moreover, they lead us to destruction, and to the path of death and to the way of perdition; from this day forth, they shall take our life away, for our hearts are hardened against Thee. This is true for all who are born, not just for a few.
And the angel returned and said unto me, "Hearken unto me, that I may speak unto thee; I shall instruct thee again."
Therefore, I have not created only one world, but rather two worlds.
But thou, the number of the righteous is few; many are not so; but the number of the wicked is great, as thou hast said.
Work with him who is in need.
And I said, "O Lord, how can this be?"
And He said unto me, "This is not the only thing; but inquire of the earth; it shall speak unto thee; it shall answer thee; it shall respond unto thee."
እነሆ፥ ወርቁን፥ ብሩንም፥ ናሱንም፥ ብረቱንና እርሳሱን፥ ሸክላውንም አንቺ ታስገኚዋለሽ በላት።
ብር ከወርቅ፥ ናስም ከብር፥ ብረትም ከናስ፥ እርሳስም ከብረት፥ ሸክላም ከእርሳስ ይበዛል።
እንግዲህ አንተ ራስህ ዕወቅ፥ የትኛው ይከብራል? የትኛውስ ይወደዳል? የሚበዛው ነውን? ወይስ የሚያንሰው ነው?”
እኔም መለስሁለት እንዲህም አልሁት፥ “ጌታዬ ሆይ የሚያንሰው ይወደዳል፤ የሚበዛውም ይረክሳል።”
እርሱም መለሰልኝ፤ እንዲህም አለኝ፥ “ያሰብኸውን አንተ ራስህ መዝነው፤ ከብዙው ካለው ይልቅ፥ ከጥቂቱ ያለው እጅግ ደስ ይለዋልና ከእኔ ዘንድ የሚገኝ የጻድቃን ደስታቸው እንደዚሁ ነው።
ስለሚድኑ ስለ ጥቂቶች ደስ ይለኛል፤ ክብሬን ያገኛሉና። ስሜም በእነርሱ ተመስግኖአልና።
ስለሚጠፉ ስለ ብዙዎች ልቡናዬን አላሳዝነውም። እነርሱ ዛሬ በእሳት ተመስለዋልና፥ እንደ እሳት ነበልባልም ሆነዋልና፥ እንደ ጢስም ነድደውና ተንነው ጠፍተዋልና።”

sections.title: The Book of Ezra

verses.text: And I answered them, saying, "O earth, why hast thou been found to have a creature unlike thee from thy ground?"
Yet, it would have been better for us if our evil hearts did not create for us than if they did create for us.
An evil heart will lead us; concerning it, it will judge us; for we shall be harmed without our knowledge.
Let not the children of men perish; but let the beasts of the wilderness rejoice; for all who were born of Adam shall perish; and let the creatures of the field rejoice.
Since there is no righteous judgment to protect them, and since they do not know judgment or hell, and since they do not hope for resurrection after death, they are much worse than we.
What shall our resurrection avail us?
For all who are born are given to sin; we are filled with iniquity; and we are strengthened in our wickedness.
I said, "It would have been better for us to go to judgment after death."

sections.title: The answer given to Ezra's inquiry.

verses.text: The angel also answered me, saying, “The Most High prepared judgment and wrath beforehand for this world, for Adam and all his descendants at the time of their creation.”
Now, rise from Your word; thus You have spoken: ‘An evil heart shall dwell with us;

Those who dwell on the earth shall be judged concerning Him, for they are without understanding, and they shall be confounded, for they have received the law in their hearts, yet they do not keep Your commandments, and they shall perish for having disregarded the law and Your commandments.
What shall they say on the day of judgment? What shall they speak in the latter days?
How much shall the Most High punish the people who dwell in this world? Yet, it is concerning the appointed time that it is said, not concerning them.”

sections.title: The state of the dead before judgment.

verses.text: And I answered him, saying, “If I have found favor in Thy sight, let this be told to Thy servant; at the time of death, when our souls depart from us, will the time of judgment be kept until it arrives? Or shall it be that from this day forth, we shall be judged?”
And he replied to me, saying, “I will tell you this; but you shall not join yourself with the wicked, nor shall you be counted among those who are judged.”
A book prepared for you in the heavens, yet until the last day it shall not be revealed to you.

Concerning death, this is the matter; when the command from on high comes forth, at the appointed time the soul shall depart from the body; and it shall return again to the One who gave it; and it shall bow down before the Most High.
If you do not keep the ways of the Most High, if you disregard the law of the Most High, and if you do not think of His fear, yet if you are among the wicked,

Those souls of the wicked shall be cast away, but they shall not enter the dwelling of the righteous; henceforth they shall receive torment; they shall be in anguish; they shall weep; and they shall show forth their transgressions.
The first decree is this; it is the law of the Most High.
The second decree is this; from now on, they shall not return to life, for they shall not be able to return.
The third decree is this; they shall see the reward prepared for them in the law of the Most High.
The fourth decree is this; they shall see the judgment that awaits them in the time to come.
አምስተኛዪቱም ሥርዐት እንዲህ ናት፤ መላእክት የጻድቃንን ነፍስ በማደሪያቸው ውስጥ በብዙ ዕረፍት ሲጠብቋቸው ያያሉና።
“ስድስተኛዪቱም ሥርዐት እንዲህ ናት፤ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ የሚያገኛቸውን መከራ እያዞሩ ያሳዩአቸዋልና።
ከነገርሁህ ሥርዐታት ሁሉ የምትበልጥ ሰባተኛዪቱ ሥርዐት እንዲህ ናት፤ በፊቱ ይፈረድባቸው ዘንድ ያላቸው ዛሬ በሕይወታቸው ሳሉ እርሱን የበደሉ በፊታቸው የልዑልን ጌትነት ባዩ ጊዜ በኀሣር ይቀልጣሉና፥ በኀፍረትም ይጐሳቈላሉና፥ በፍርሀትም ይጠወልጋሉና።
“የልዑልን ሕግ የጠበቁ ግን ከመዋቲ ሥጋቸው በሚለዩበት ጊዜ ሥርዐታቸው እንዲህ ናት።
በኖረበት ዘመን ሁሉ ያስተማራቸው የልዑልን ሕግ ይፈጽሙ ዘንድ መከራቸውን ታግሠው ሁልጊዜ በድካም ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዝተውለታልና።
ስለዚህ ነገራቸው እንዲህ ነው።
መጀመሪያ የተቀባያቸውን የእግዚአብሔርን ጌትነት በብዙ ደስታ ያያሉ፤ ወደ ሰባቱም ሥርዐታት ይወስዷቸዋል።
መጀመሪያዪቱ ሥርዐት እንዲህ ናት፤ በዛሬው ሕይወታቸው በሞት እንዳያስታቸው በእነርሱ ያለ ክፉ አሳብን ድል ይነሡ ዘንድ በብዙ ድካም ተጋድለዋልና።
ሁለተኛዪቱም ሥርዐት እንዲህ ናት፤ የኃጥኣንን ነፍሳት በሚዞሩበት ያዩአቸዋልና፤ የሚጠብቃቸውንም ፍርድ ያያሉና።
ሦስተኛዪቱም ሥርዐት እንዲህ ናት፥ በሕይወት ሳሉ በሃይማኖት የተቀበሉትን ሕጉን እንደ ጠበቁ የፈጠራቸው ምስክር ይሆንላቸዋልና።

And the fourth order is this: The angels, while they are awaiting, shall behold the great joy in their abodes, from this day forth, as they shall receive rest and witness the honor that is bestowed upon them.

And the fifth order is this: Today, how they have triumphed over death, and afterward, as they inherit what is theirs, they shall rejoice, for they shall not behold death again; and as the weary rise from their slumber, they shall see the abundant life that they gain. Even in the absence of death, they shall rejoice forever.
And the sixth order is this: Their faces shall shine as the sun, and their brightness shall be like the stars, as they shall be shown forth; from henceforth, they shall not die.

And the seventh order, which is above all, is this: They shall be honored in His presence, and they shall receive value, for while they are in life, they shall behold the face of Him who has redeemed them, and they shall rejoice with great joy, for they are not afraid.

"From this day forth, the order of the souls of the righteous is this: They shall receive comfort from the afflictions of the world, which I have spoken to you; this is their path and their judgment."
And I answered Him, saying, "After the separation from the flesh, shall this which You have spoken to me be given for the soul on the day of judgment?"
"In those seven days, they shall behold all that I have spoken to you, for on the seventh day they are free; and thereafter, they shall return to their place," He said to me.
And I answered Him, saying, "O my Lord, if I have found grace in Your sight, let this also be told to Your servant; on the day of judgment, shall the righteous stand before the wicked to be judged?"

Fathers shall be merciful to their children, and children to their fathers; brothers shall be merciful to their brothers, and generations to their generations; and friends shall be merciful to their friends.
And He answered me, saying, "I have found grace in Your sight, and I will tell you this: The day of judgment is for one time; it shall show the seal of truth upon every command."

Today, a father for his son, and a son for his father; a lord for his servant, and a friend for his friend, they shall rest in peace, and their hearts shall rejoice, and they shall be delivered as if they were not forsaken.

Likewise, there is no one who can completely exchange with another; nor is there anyone who can return his own burden upon his neighbor. For each shall receive his own reward, and his work shall be his own.
I also responded to him thus: “In former times, Abraham concerning Sodom and Gomorrah, and Moses in the wilderness during the time of our fathers, how did we find ourselves today?”
In the days of Isaiah concerning Israel, and Samuel in the days of Saul,
David concerning the cherubim, Solomon concerning the temple, and Elijah concerning the prophets and the dead,
Hezekiah in the days of the Assyrians for the people, and many people concerning the multitude.
Therefore, today, while the world is alive, and sin is abounding, how can the righteous be delivered from the wicked?
And he answered me, saying, “The world of today has not yet reached its end; and the glory of the Lord shall not dwell within it forever. Therefore, let us strive earnestly for the needy.”
The day of judgment is the end of this world; the world shall not pass away, and that which does not pass away shall be established for the world to come.
After this, the poor shall be enriched; the needy shall be delivered; righteousness shall be exalted; and truth shall endure.
There is no one who can say, "Forgive the man who has risen in judgment," for there is no one who can alleviate the suffering of the one who has triumphed.
And I answered him, saying, "My word is as it was before; even now I say this: The earth was better when it did not contain Adam; for it was made to be without sorrow, lest it be burdened by him."
What shall our life be that we dwell in? For we shall live in sorrow; and after death, a judgment shall surely come upon us.
O Adam! What have you done? Had you not sinned, this affliction would not have come upon us.
What hope have you given us? What shall the world be that comes without death? Yet we have performed the work that brings forth death.
We have not done the good that was spoken of; yet we have committed evil deeds. We have also followed the wicked.
We have not followed the houses prepared for us that are free from sorrow. Yet we have committed sin.
Those who have endured affliction are the righteous who have received the heavenly kingdom; yet we have lived in our wickedness.
The fruit that does not perish shall be revealed in heaven, for within it is joy and life.
Yet we do not comprehend; for we shall perform the work for which we are to be praised.
Those who have sought righteousness shall shine before Him; but our countenance shall be more dim than darkness.
Behold, after death, we shall live without knowing what is upon us.
And the angel answered me, saying, "In this world, for those who are born of the earth, this is what is appointed."
Victory shall be granted to me for what I have not done; but victory shall be granted to you for what you have not done.
Choose life, as Moses spoke to the people, saying, "This is the way." Yet they did not accept him; and after him, the prophets whom I spoke of were also not accepted.
For those who believe, there is joy; for those who perish, there is no sorrow.
And I answered him, saying, "O Lord, whenever those who have sinned say, 'Forgive us,' may it not be said today, 'Let it be forgiven,' for I know it is done."
It is not forgiven; for those who have returned to the law, He shall say, 'Forgive them.'
It is merciful; for He shall have compassion on those who have sinned as children.
It is just; for according to their deeds, as it is fitting for them, shall men be given.
His mercy is indeed abundant; for those who are called, and for those who are commanded, they shall be praised, for His grace has exceedingly multiplied upon them.
If His grace had not exceedingly multiplied, this world would not have existed, for those who are in Him would not have existed.
It is for the sake of the wicked; for if He had not granted His grace, every man would have perished from their sins.
It is a wonder; if He had not preserved the creation He made, the multitude of the wicked would have perished, for their number would not remain. If that were not the case, there would be very few.
The angel also answered me, saying, "This world was created for the many; however, the one to come was created for the few."

"Ezra! Behold, I will explain the parable before you; the earth is inquiring of you; it shall speak to you; for from him, the land that is found shall be given to you, and the land shall yield gold from him, and indeed, the abundance of silver shall increase greatly."
The works of this world are thus; within it, there are many that are created; however, those who are saved are but few."
And I answered him, saying, "Let the heart rejoice that has arisen from wisdom; and the ear shall drink in the matter."
The ear is made to hear, and the heart is created to know; for man, apart from a little life, shall depart without being loved."

O Lord, for your servant has been granted; that in this world, with the money that man can possess, all the dead may dwell, that they may be afraid, and that we may be fruitful; that if you grant us our hearts and our minds, it would be better for us."
The creation of your hands, we are all as you have spoken."

Today you shall create in the womb, and you shall form flesh and bones; you shall also give understanding; you shall preserve it in fire and in water; that which you have created, in the womb for nine months, you shall carry; and in you, the word shall be kept."
And again, the mother, at the time of her giving birth, after she has borne and created, until the months of nurturing are completed, this your servant shall grow to be a child."
Above her body, from her breasts, the fruit of the breast and milk shall be given to nourish you."
ይህ ባሪያህ እስከ ጊዜው ድረስ ያድግ ዘንድ በቸርነትህ ታሳድገዋለህ።
በቸርነትህም ትመግበዋለህ፤ ሕግህንም ታስተምረዋለህ፤ በጥበብህም ትገሥጸዋለህ።
ከዚህ በኋላ የፈጠርኸውንና ሕያው ያደረግኸውን ያን ባሪያህን ትገድለዋለህ።
ፈጥረህ ይህን ያህል ዘመን ያኖርኸውን ያን ባሪያህን የምታጠፋው ከሆነ እንግዲያ ለምን ፈጠርኸው?
አሁንም ነገርህ እውነት ነው፤ ስለ ሁሉም አንተ ታውቃለህ፤ ነገር ግን እናገር ዘንድ እኔን ያተጋኝ አይደለም።
ይህን የማዝን ስለ ወገኖችህና ስለ ርስትህ ነው እንጂ።
ይህንም በፊትህ እማልድ ዘንድ የጀመርሁት ስለ እኔም፥ ስለ እነዚያም ነው። የሚመጣውን ዓለም ሕጉን እየሰማን የምንኖር የእኛን መሰነካከል አያለሁና።
ስለዚህም ቃሌን ስማ፤ በፊትህ የምናገረውንም ልመናዬን አድምጥልኝ።”

sections.title: The Prayer of Ezra

verses.text: This is the beginning of the prayer of Ezra, which shall not be disregarded.
"O Lord, who dwells forever, exalted and lifted up, who art seen in the heavens,
Thy dominion is unshaken, Thy kingdom shall not be moved; the hosts of angels stand in awe before Thee,
the wind and the fire were created at Thy command; Thy word is strong, and that which Thou hast spoken shall endure.
Thy decree is steadfast, Thy command is to be feared; Thy command brings down the proud, and Thy wrath shakes the mountains; Thy law is truth.
O Lord, hear the words of Thy servant; regard the prayer of Thy servant, and grant my request.
While I live, I shall declare unto Thee; my heart shall speak as it is able; I shall return unto Thee.
Do not regard the iniquities of my kin; rather, behold their righteousness which hath been given unto Thee.
Do not regard the works of the wicked; rather, consider the order which they have kept in their affliction.
Before Thee, do not be angry for the evil deeds they have committed; rather, think upon those whose hearts are fully trusting in Thy law."
Do not destroy those who are like beasts in their deeds. Consider those who call upon Your law with a bright heart; look upon them, indeed.
Do not be angry with those who are wicked among men. In Your lordship, have mercy upon those who have been afflicted.
Yet, we have performed deeds that bring forth death, which were done before us.
But as for You, concerning us, let there be no wrath against those who have sinned; if You should say to us, "Forgive," may it not be that You are unable to forgive us.
Yet, concerning the righteous who are prepared with good deeds, You may indeed say to them, "Forgive them" in their works.
What is the matter with a man that You should be angry? What is the matter with him that You should be wrathful against the one who is afflicted?
Now, I speak the truth that there is none who is beyond reproach from the lineage that has been born.
Yet, O Lord, if You should say to those who have no good deeds, "Forgive them," Your mercy shall surely be known.
And He answered me, saying, "You have spoken the truth concerning Me; as you have spoken, so it is."
For those who are guilty, death, judgment, and destruction, I do not truly desire for them.
ነገር ግን ስለ ጻድቃን ደስ ይለኛል፤ የሚድኑ ዋጋቸውን ያገኛሉና።
እንደ ተናገርኸውም እንዲሁ ይሆናል።
ገበሬ ብዙ ዘር እንደሚዘራ፥ ብዙ ተክልንም እንደሚተክል፥ ጊዜውም ቢሆን ዘሩ ሁሉ የሚበቅል እንደ አይደለ፥ ተክሉም ሁሉ ሥር የሚሰድድ እንደ አይደለ፥ በዚህ ዓለም ያሉ ሰዎችም እንዲሁ ናቸው፤ ሁሉም የሚድኑ አይደሉም።”
እኔም መለስሁለት፤ እንዲህም አልሁት፥ “በፊትህ ባለሟልነትንስ ካገኘሁ ልናገር።
የገበሬ ዘርስ ባይበቅል ምናልባት ዝናም ባያገኝ ይሆናል፤ ስለዚህም ይጠፋል።
ነገር ግን በእጅህ የፈጠርኸው፥ በአምሳልህም የመሰልኸው ሰው አምሳልህ ነውና፥ ስለ እርሱም ሁሉን ፈጥረሃልና፥ እንግዲህ እንደ ገበሬ ዘር ለምን ታደርገዋለህ?
አቤቱ አገባብህም አይደለም፤ ለወገኖችህ ራራ፤ ርስትህንም ይቅር በል እንጂ፤ ፍጥረትህን ይቅር ትለዋለህና።”
እርሱም መለሰልኝ፤ እንዲህም አለኝ፥ “በዚህ ዓለም ያለው በዚህ ዓለም ላሉት ምሳሌያቸው ነው፤ የወዲያው ዓለም ግን በወዲያው ዓለም ለሚኖሩ ምሳሌያቸው ነው።
ነገር ግን ዕውቀት ያነሰህ አንተ ከእኔ ይልቅ ፍጥረቴን ፈጽመህ ትወድድ ዘንድ፥ ይልቁንም አንተ ኃጥእ ሳትሆን በብዙ ወገን ኃጥእን ትመስላለህ።
ነገር ግን ስለዚህ በልዑል ዘንድ ትመሰገናለህ፤
Thou hast cast down thyself, and though thou hast completed thy work, thou dost not regard thyself as a righteous one.
Even now, those who dwell in this world shall suffer much tribulation in the days to come, for they have lived in great pride.
But thou, know thyself; and consider the honor that is given unto thee.

For paradise is opened unto you, and the tree of life is planted; and the world to come is prepared and fashioned, and joy is established therein, and rest is granted, and good blessings are secured, for the wisdom of the Lord is found therein.
Therefore, death hath vanished; the grave is made desolate; and sorrow hath fled away.
Tribulation hath ceased; and the book of life is revealed.
Therefore, do not be weary in considering the multitude of those who perish.
For they have obtained freedom, and have cast aside the law, and they have forsaken the ordinance.
They have also oppressed the righteous.
As they are aware of their death, in their hearts they do not seek the Lord God.
Therefore, this is good for you, and likewise, this calamity is for them.
They have blasphemed the name of their Creator after they were created, and they have not given thanks to the Lord who prepared for them.
Now their judgment shall come upon them.
For you and as for you, I have spoken this to the few, but I have not spoken this to the many.”
And I answered him; and I said, “O Lord! Behold, until now, You have shown me many signs concerning the age that is to come; however, You have not told me when it shall be.”
መልአኩም መለሰልኝ እንዲህም አለኝ፥ “አንተ ራስህ ገምግመው፤ እኔ ከነገርሁህ ምልክት ያለፈ ብታይ፥
ልዑል የፈጠረውን ዓለም ይጐበኝበት ዘንድ ያለው ጊዜ እንደ ደረሰ ያንጊዜ ዕወቅ።
በዓለም በየሀገሩ ሽብር በሆነ ጊዜ፥ አሕዛብም በታወኩ ጊዜ፥ ሕዝቡም በተሸበሩ ጊዜ፥ አለቆችም በተዋጉ ጊዜ፥ መሳፍንቱም በደነገጡ ጊዜ፥
ስለዚህ ልዑል ከጊዜው አስቀድሞ እንደ ተናገረ ያንጊዜ ዕወቅ።
በዓለም የሆነው ሁሉ አስቀድሞ በቃል፥ ኋላም በመገለጥ እንደ ሆነ፥
እንዲሁም የልዑል ዓለም መጀመሪያ በቃል፥ በተአምርና በኀይል፥ ኋላ ግን በሥራና በድንቅ ነው።
በምግባሩና በአመነበት ሃይማኖቱ የዳነና ማምለጥ የቻለ፥
ከነገርሁህ ሥቃይ የሚድን እርሱ ብቻ ነው፤ ከዚህ ዓለም ለእኔ በለየኋት በምድሬና በድንበሬም ሕይወትን ያያል።
ዛሬ ትእዛዜን ቸል ያሉ ያንጊዜ መከራን ይቀበላሉ፤ እኔን መፍራትን የተዉና የናቁኝም በገሃነም ውስጥ ይጨነቃሉ።
እኔ እየረዳኋቸው በሕይወታቸው ሳሉ የማያውቁኝም ሁሉ፥
They are free, yet all who are bound by My law,
For the place of my hope is open to them, yet they do not regard my heart; all who awaken me, they do not know me after death.
But you, do not inquire how the mighty will judge them; rather, inquire how the righteous will fare in their world, for the world to come is concerning them.
And I answered them; thus I said:
"Indeed, as the harvest exceeds the reapers, so too will those who perish increase beyond those who are saved; I have spoken of this before, and today I shall speak of it again."
And He answered me, saying, "The measure of the harvest is as it is; the judgment is according to its work; and the measure of the gleaning is according to its yield."
Today, the world prepared for them within it shall not be disturbed, for it is in its time.
At that time, there was none who had wronged me; for there was none who existed.
Even now, in the absence of food and desire, in the world prepared by the eternal law, after they were created, there was death in their work.
When I beheld the world, behold, they perished. In the work sown upon the earth, behold, the world shall tremble.
And I went and gathered the little ones; and from the abundance, I set aside fruits for myself. I chose one tree from many.
The multitude of those born in vain shall perish; but the fruit of much labor shall be preserved, and the tree shall be kept.
But you, if you fast and pray for seven days,
if you go to the desolate land where no work is done, and eat only the fruit of the tree, and do not eat flesh, and if you drink only water,
if you pray to the Most High at all times, I will come and speak to you.

sections.title: The Fourth Vision

verses.text: ከዚህ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘኝ ስሙ አርፋድ ወደሚባል ምድረ በዳ ሄድሁ።
በሣር ውስጥ ተቀመጥሁ፤ የምድረ በዳንም ፍሬ ተመገብሁ፤ የበላሁትም ያጠግበኝ ነበር።
ከዚህም ከሰባተኛው ቀን በኋላ በሣር ውስጥ ተኝቼ ሳለሁ ልቤ እንደ ቀድሞው ታወከብኝ።
አንደበቴንም አቅንቼ በልዑል ፊት እናገር ጀመርሁ፤
እንዲህም አልሁ፥ “አቤቱ ጌታዬ፥ ዛፍና ሣር በሌሉበት ምድረ በዳ ለአባቶቻችን ፈጽመህ ታየሃቸው።
እንዲህም አልሃቸው፦ ‘አንተ እስራኤል ስማኝ፤ ቃሌንም አድምጠኝ፤
እነሆም እኔ ሕጌን በውስጣችሁ እዘራለሁና፥ በላያችሁም ፍሬን ያፈራልና፥ ለዘለዓለሙም ትከብሩበታላቸሁና።’
አባቶቻችንም ሕግህን ተቀብለው አልጠበቁም፤ በሥርዐትህም አልጸኑም፤ የሕግህ ፍሬ ግን አልጠፋም፤ የአንተ ገንዘብ ስለሆነ ይጠፋ ዘንድ አይቻልምና።
ሕግ ያንተ ገንዘብ ስለሆነች በውስጣቸው የተዘራውን ተግባራቸውን አልጠበቁምና ሕግህን ተቀብለው ያልጠበቁ ጠፉ።
ምድርም ዘርን ከተቀበለች በኋላ፥ ባሕርም መርከብ በውስጧ ከገባ በኋላ፥ ዕቃም በውስጡ መብልና መጠጥን ከጨመሩበት በኋላ፥

"At that time, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give its light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken. Yet those who are faithful shall endure. For us, it shall not be so. We shall perish for our transgressions, for we have accepted the law, and our hearts shall likewise be affected; but the law shall remain in its glory and shall not perish."

sections.title: Concerning the woman who is forsaken, the vision of Ezra.

verses.text: And when I looked with mine eyes, behold, on the right side, I saw a woman who was in distress; she cried out with a loud voice; indeed, she was greatly sorrowful; her heart was troubled; and upon her head was a crown of thorns.
That which I had previously considered was distinct from me; and turning to her, I said, "What troubles you? Why is your heart grieved? Speak unto me."
And she said unto me, "My lord, I am in distress, and my affliction is multiplied; truly, I am in sorrow, for my heart is troubled."
And I said, "What has befallen you? Speak unto me."
And she answered me, saying, "I have been your servant from ancient times; for thirty years I have dwelt with my master, and I have not borne a child."
And I, in those thirty years, at all times and in every hour, in the morning and in the night, did pray unto the Most High.

And after thirty years, the Lord heard the prayer of His servant; He beheld my affliction; and considering my weakness and my sorrow, He granted me a son; and in him, I found great joy; and I, and my husband, and all the people of my land rejoiced; we gave thanks unto the Lord.
In much affliction, I was comforted.
And after this, when the measure of my days was fulfilled, my wife bore me a son; and I took her to be my wife.
"And after this, when he entered the pit, he fell and died."

"And after this, we shall extinguish our lamp and our light; let us sit in silence, for all the people of my land have risen and they have begun to seek me and to comfort me; from this time until the day of her destruction, I shall remain silent through the night."
"And after this, when all were silent, at the time when they forsook to counsel me, I arose in the night and fled; and I came to this wilderness."

"For I shall dwell here forever, but I have made a vow that I shall not return to my land; I shall always be in mourning; until death, I shall remain in sorrow, but I shall not eat bread; nor shall I drink water."
"That which I pondered has come to pass; and I answered them; and thus I spoke unto them:"
"Among all women, thou art the most blessed; dost thou not see our lamentation that we have suffered?"
"For all of us, our mother, concerning Zion, we are in sorrow; we have endured affliction and have received it."
"Even now, truly, it is fitting that thou shouldst weep; for we all are in sorrow; and we also weep for the many; but thou, for thy one son, dost thou weep."
"The earth shall call unto thee; she shall speak unto thee; for in her, because of those who were born, it is fitting that she should mourn for herself."
"All were created from ancient times upon her; behold, others have come and sought to utterly destroy her."
Therefore, who is it that is worthy of such a fate? Is it not true that you have lost much? Or are you grieving for your child alone?
Or is it that I have caused my child, whom I bore in pain and anguish, to perish? Is my lamentation not like that of the earth?
But the earth, indeed, has many nations that have come to her; thus they have departed.
Yet I shall speak thus; you shall be as a mother, and the earth, from ancient times, has given her fruits to those created within her.
Now, do not let this sorrow of yours depart from you; for concerning what you have found, you shall endure both wrath and suffering.
If you give thanks to the Lord, He shall help you, and your child shall be found in due time; and among women, you shall be known for the suffering you have endured.
Now, go to your land; and go to your husband.
And she said to him, “I shall not do this; for in this I shall die, and I shall not return to my land.”
And the messenger spoke to her, saying, “Do not do this.”
“Do not act upon this matter; behold, I shall take care of you; and let your own suffering be as the anguish of Zion; for concerning the city of Jerusalem, be steadfast.”
ቤተ መቅደሳችን እንደ ፈረሰ፥ መሠዊያችን እንደ ተሰባበረ አታዪምን?

ግናያቱ እንደ ጠፋ፥ ምስጋናችን እንደ ቀረ፥ ዘመራ ዘውዳችን እንደ ወደቀ፥ የመቅረዛችን መብራት እንደ ጠፋ፥ የቃል ኪዳናችን ታቦት እንደ ተማረከች፥ ንዋየ ቅድሳታችን እንዳደፈ፥ ስማችን እንደ ረከሰ፥ ጌቶቻችን እንደ ተዋረዱ፥ ካህኖቻችን እንደ ተቃጠሉ፥ ሌዋውያኖቻችን እንደ ተማረኩ፥ ደናግሎቻችን እንደ ተገደሉ፥ ሚስቶቻችንን እንደ ቀሙን፥ ጻድቃኖቻችን እንደ ተጐተቱ፥ ጐልማሶቻችን እንደ ተገዙ፥ ወንዶች ልጆቻችን እንደ ተቀሙ፥ አርበኞቻችን እንደ ደከሙ አታዪምን?
ከዚህ ሁሉ የሚበልጥ ጽዮን ጠፋች፤ ክብርዋም ከእርስዋ ወጣ፤ በጠላቶቻችንም እጅ ወደቅን።
አንቺም ተዪ፥ ልዑልና ኀያል ይቅር ይልሽ ዘንድ፥ ከድካምሽም እግዚአብሔር ፈጽሞ ያሳርፍሽ ዘንድ ይህን ብዙ ኀዘንሽን አርቂ።”
ከዚህ በኋላ ይኽን ስናገራት ድንገት ፊትዋ ከፀሐይ ይልቅ በራ፤ መልኳም እንደ መብረቅ አንጸባረቀ፤ ወደ እርሷ መቅረብንም ፈራሁ፤ ልቡናዬም ደነገጠብኝ፤ ከዚህም በኋላ ይህ ምን እንደ ሆነ ሳስብ አስደነገጠችኝ።
በታላቅ ድምፅም ጮኸች፤ ከድምፅዋም የተነሣ ምድር እስክትነዋወጥ ድረስ ድምፅዋ እጅግ የሚያስፈራ ሆነ።
ባየኋትም ጊዜ እነሆ የከበረችና የታነጸች ከተማ ነበረች እንጂ ሴት አልነበረችም፤ ታላቅ የሆነ የመሠረቶችዋንም ቦታ አየሁ፤ ፈርቼም በታላቅ ድምፅ ጮህኹ። እንዲህም አልሁ፦
“አስቀድሞ ወደ እኔ የመጣህ መልአኩ ዑርኤል፥ አንተ ወዴት ነህ? ወደ ብዙ ምርምር እገባ ዘንድ፥ ፍጻሜዬም ለጕስቍልናዬ ትሆን ዘንድ፥ ጸሎቴም ለተግዳሮት ይሆን ዘንድ እንዲህ ለምን አደረግኸኝ?”

sections.title: The interpretation of the vision.

verses.text: And as I spoke thus, behold, the angel that came to me before came to me.
I was in a deep sleep; my understanding was not with me; and he held my right hand and strengthened me; and he set me upon my feet.
He said to me, “What is the matter with you? Why are you troubled? Why is your heart not with you?”

And I answered him, “You have sought me, and you have separated me; for I have come to this wilderness as you have spoken to me; and behold, when I came to this wilderness, I saw that which I cannot understand.”
And he said to me, “Now speak, as a man.”
And I answered him, “Lord, do not separate me, lest I die like a man.”
For I cannot understand what I have seen, and I have heard that which I do not know.
But perhaps my heart may be troubled; may my body be distressed?
Now, Lord, tell me plainly; explain this vision to your servant.”
And he answered me, saying, “Because you are afraid, I will teach you; for this is a hidden mystery: the Most High God has revealed it to you.”
Thou hast seen thy righteousness; for concerning thy kindred, thou art greatly troubled; and concerning Zion, thou dost exceedingly lament.
The matter is this:
In times past, as thou didst behold her, she was as a forsaken woman, and she was as one who hath begun to be comforted.
But now, the woman whom thou seest is not as she was; she is a city that hath been forsaken.
For she speaketh of her child’s affliction.
Behold, the woman thou seest today is as a forsaken city, yet she is Zion, which thou dost behold.
For in the midst of thirty generations, this is what hath been; the offerings presented are without count, for the world hath endured three thousand years.
And after three thousand years, Solomon built the city; at that time, he offered sacrifices. And this woman is the mother of the child she bore.
This is the time of great sorrow that hath befallen thee, O Jerusalem, which hath endured.
For when her child entered into the cradle, he fell and died; this is the affliction that hath befallen thee, O Jerusalem, in thy desolation.
Behold, how she has regarded her children, and thou, O woman of Jerusalem, art she who began to be comforted from her affliction.

Now, O exalted Lord God, may she be adorned in thy perfect body, and may thy perfect heart be stirred, for thou hast shown her the beauty of her joy and the revelation of her honor. For it is a hidden mystery.
Therefore, I shall speak unto thee, that thou mayest dwell in this wilderness where a house hath not been built.
O exalted Lord God, I know all that is before thee.
Therefore, I shall speak unto thee, that thou mayest come to this place where the foundation of the building is not.
O exalted one, it cannot be that a man's work should be built in the place where he is revealed.
"Fear not, for thou shalt not be dismayed; behold, look upon her brightness and the strength of her building."
Hear that which thou art able to hear with thine ears.
Thou hast made thyself more pure than many, and in the sight of the exalted, thou art as one who is few.
Even today, I stand here.
ልዑል እግዚአብሔር በዓለም በሚኖሩ ሰዎች ላይ በጊዜው የሚያደርገውን ራእይ ነገ በሕልም ያሳይሃል።”
በዚያችም ሌሊት፥ በማግሥቱም እንዳዘዘኝ አደርሁ።

sections.title: The fifth vision which he beheld in a parable.

verses.text: And after this, in the night of the vision, as I came forth from the sea, I beheld in a dream; and its wings were twelve, and its heads were three.
By its wings, it shall be exalted over all the earth; and all the winds of heaven shall blow upon it; and the clouds shall gather upon it.
From those wings, the heads shall be lifted; and those heads shall be small and delicate wings.
And the heads shall be silent; but among those heads, the middle head shall be greater; yet it too shall be silent with them.
That vision shall possess the earth and all that dwell upon the earth, for it shall be exalted by its wings;
All that is beneath heaven shall be possessed by it, for that vision shall be greater than any creature that was created upon the earth.
After this, that vision arose; it stood upon its feet; and with a great voice, it cried out; and it said unto its wings:
“In your places, you shall lie down, but all of you shall not rise in unity; at each time, you shall rise up.”
The last head shall be greater than all.”
When I beheld, the voice that came forth was from among its flesh, but it was not from within its head.
The number of those heads is eight.
And after this, he went out to the right side; and he possessed all the land.
And after this, when the destruction had come, his place was lost until it could not be seen; and he also perished; and the second one went out; and he possessed for a long time.
And after this, when the destruction had come, he also perished like the first one.
A word came forth; and it said thus:
"You shall possess the earth for this length of time, and you shall be a witness that you do not perish; this is what I say to you."
"There shall not be one after you that will endure, nor one that will possess as much as your portion."
The third one also went out; and he also possessed like the first one; and after this, he also perished.
And after this, all the second ones went out; and each one possessed; and all the second ones perished.
And after this, the second ones possessed until they were lifted up to the left side at their appointed times; but they hastened and perished.
Among them were those who arose; yet they did not prevail against them.
And thereafter, those two of the ten horns fell; and the two of them also fell from themselves.
Silence, it is said, remained from the three horns and from the six horns; there remained none from this side of the river.
And after this, from among them, two of the six horns were separated and went; and they settled within the one that was on the right side; but the four remained in their place.
But these four horns stood firm, and they also prevailed to be established.
And after this, one arose and stood; yet swiftly it perished.
The second also, in like manner, perished swiftly more than the first.
And after this, those who remained, these two, were united to prevail, and thus they were established.
And after this, while they were establishing, silence was said; from the three horns, one arose in the midst; and he was greater than them.
And after this, they took the two horns and brought them to him.
And that head turned back, having joined together with those who were with him; they seized the two heads that had been placed upon you.
That head ruled over all the earth; and within it, those who dwelt therein were afflicted with much suffering and distress; more than all the limbs that stood, it utterly darkened the world.
After this, the middle head was lost like those.
The two heads remained; and they too seized the earth and those who dwelt within it.
After this, that head which was on the right side seized that which was on the left side.

sections.title: The lion that came forth from the forest.

verses.text: "Look unto thy face; I have heard the word that saith, 'What thou seest, know.'"
"And when I beheld, behold, a lion arose from the forest; and as a man spoke, I heard its voice; and it said unto the beast, thus:"
"Hearken unto thy speech, and unto the greatness that is within thee."
"Shall the earth be taken by thee, which was created for them, and thou art not among the four creatures that remain until the end of time?"
"The fourth also came, and with much toil and pain, it shall conquer all those creatures that have remained in this world; thus, this age has dwelt in this world in turmoil."
"And the world has been seized by wicked oppression."

"For they have taken away the righteous, and have cast down the humble; they have oppressed the meek, and have driven away the seekers of wisdom; they have devoured the righteous, and have consumed the innocent."
"For sin hath reached unto the heights, and pride hath ascended unto the mighty."
"And the mighty hath turned his gaze upon his own people; behold, the year is fulfilled."

"Therefore, thou beast, if thou complete thy course, thou shalt perish; for the sinners shall be thy limbs, and the wicked shall be thy head, and the evil shall be thy foundation, and the mighty flesh shall perish."
The earth, in all its affliction, shall cry out, and when Thou dost complete it, it shall proclaim the judgment and the goodness of its Creator.
And after this, the Creator spoke this word at the time He had declared it,
The remnant was lost; and those who came to Him were lifted up by those very arms; and they were to be sold, that they might be lifted up; and by their destruction they were known.
After this, they also perished; their flesh was all consumed; and the earth rejoiced exceedingly. And I too, having arisen from much distress, rejoiced; and in great fear I was awakened.
My heart also said unto me, “When thou dost inquire into the work of the Most High, thou hast done all this unto me.”
My body was weakened; and my heart was greatly troubled; in much fear I was driven, and I had no strength; and in this night I rejoiced.
Even now, for eternity, I will call upon the Most High.
Thus I said, “O Lord, if I have found favor in Thy sight, and if I have been found pure before Thee, and my prayer has reached before Thee,
Deliver me; strengthen me; and let my soul rejoice exceedingly, that which is fearful, explain this dream to Thy servant.
For after the time that is to come and the vanity of the world, Thou hast made me pure.”

sections.title: The interpretation of the vision.

verses.text: መልአኩም እንዲህ አለኝ፥ “ያየኸው የዚህ ሕልምህ ትርጓሜ እንዲህ ነው።
ከባሕር ሲወጣ ያየኸው ይህ ንስር ለወንድምህ ለዳንኤል በሕልም የታየችው አራተኛዋ መንግሥት ናት።
ነገር ግን ዛሬ ለአንተ እኔ እንደተረጐምሁልህ ለእርሱ አልተረጐምሁለትም።
እነሆ፥ ዘመን ይመጣል፤ በምድርም ከእርስዋ አስቀድሞ ከነበሩት መንግሥታት ይልቅ የምታስፈራ መንግሥት ትነሣለች።
በእርሷም ዐሥራ ሁለት ነገሥታት በተከታታይ ይነግሣሉ።
ቀጥሎ የሚነግሠውም በዘመኑ ከዐሥራ ሁለቱ ነገሥታት ፈጽሞ የሚጸና ነው።
ያየሃቸው የእኒህ የዐሥራ ሁለቱ ክንፎች ትርጓሜ ይህ ነው።
ቃልን ሲናገር ያየኸው ይህም ከሥጋው መካከል ነው እንጂ ከራሱ የሚወጣ ሁለተኛው አይደለም።
ትርጓሜውም እንዲህ ነው፤ ከዚያ መንግሥት ወገን መካከል ብዙ ሁከት ይፈጠራል፤ መንግሥትም ለመውደቅ ትንገዳገዳለች፤ ነገር ግን ጸንታ ትኖራለች እንጂ ያንጊዜ አትወድቅም።
ከክንፎቹም ራሶች ሲወጡ ያየኸው ይህ፥
The interpretation is as follows: The seven kings shall reign among themselves; their time shall be short, and their days shall be troubled; yet two of them shall swiftly perish in their time.
However, the four kingdoms shall remain until the time when they are to perish; and the two shall endure for many ages.
"Be silent and behold, these three heads also:
The interpretation is this: After the great time, three kings shall arise; they shall greatly increase within themselves; and they shall oppress the earth.
Those who dwell within them shall be greatly oppressed more than all who were before them. Therefore, they are called the heads of oppression.
They are the beginnings of the kingdom, and they are also the ends of the kingdom.
And when this shall perish, one great head shall be seen, being crushed by a great sword in his sleep; he is one of them.
The remaining two, however, shall perish by the sword.
One of the last shall also perish by the sword.
"On the right side, behold, those who went to the land, these two heads also you have seen,
This is the interpretation: The exalted one is the guardian of the age to come; the first calamity shall befall them; and as you have seen, much silence shall be observed.
As it emerges from the wilderness, it speaks in all things that it has seen and recounts all its transgressions; behold, this is also a lion.

The exalted one has reserved for the age to come, and from the lineage of David shall it be born; it shall come and declare their iniquities; for their wickedness, it shall condemn them; and before them, their judgment shall be revealed.
While they are in life, it shall first stand in judgment against them; and after their condemnation, it shall utterly destroy them.
Yet their reward shall be bestowed upon them in the land of the righteous; and until the day of judgment that I have spoken of comes, it shall bring them joy.
The vision you have seen is this; and the interpretation is as follows.
The exalted one has made it so that you alone may know this mystery.
However, write all that you have seen; and in the place where it is hidden, let it be revealed.
This mystery also, that they may keep it in their hearts, you shall teach to the wise.
But you, the exalted one, shall show what you love; thus, let it be established for seven days in this manner.

sections.title: The people gathered unto Ezra as they were assembled.

verses.text: ከዚህም በኋላ ከእኔ ተለይቶ ሄደ፤ እኒያ ሰባት ቀኖች እንዳለፉ፥ እኔም ወደ ከተማ እንዳልገባሁ ሰዎች ሁሉ በሰሙ ጊዜ፥ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ትንሹም ትልቁም ተሰብስበው ወደ እኔ መጡ፤ እንዲህም አሉኝ፦
“እኛን ትተኸን በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ትኖር ዘንድ ምን በደልንህ? ምንስ ግፍ ሠራንብህ?
ከሚለቅሙት ፍሬ ሁሉ እንደ አንድ ፍሬ፥ በጨለማ ቦታ ውስጥም እንደ አለ መብራት፥ ከጥልቅም እንደሚያድን የመርከብ ወደብ ከነቢያት ሁሉ አንድ አንተ ብቻ ቀርተህልናልና።
ወይስ ያገኘችን መከራ አልበቃችንምን?
አንተስ የምትለየን ከሆነ ጽዮን በተቃጠለች ጊዜ ብንኖር በተሻለን ነበር፤
በዚያ ከሞቱት ሰዎች እኛ የምንሻል አይደለንምና።” በታላቅ ድምፅም አለቀሱ።
እኔም መለስሁላቸው፤ እንዲህም አልሁአቸው፥ “የያዕቆብ ልጆች እመኑ፤ የእስራኤልም ወገኖች አትዘኑ።
መታሰቢያችን በልዑል ፊት አለና፥ የማይዘነጋን እርሱም ጽኑዕ ነውና።
እኔስ አልተዋችሁም፤ ከእናንተም አልርቅም፤ ነገር ግን ወደዚህ ቦታ የመጣሁት ስለ ጽዮን ጥፋት እለምን ዘንድ ነው፤ በደስታችን ላይ ስለ መጣብንም መከራ ይቅርታን እለምን ዘንድ ነው።
አሁንም ሁላችሁ ወደየቤታችሁ ግቡ፤ እኔም ወደ እናንተ እመጣለሁ።”
And after those days, the people entered the city and went to their homes as they were commanded.
But I, as the angel commanded me, remained in that place in the wilderness for seven days; I fed only on the fruit of the wilderness, and during those seven days I ate the locusts of the wilderness.

sections.title: The Sixth Vision

verses.text: After this, on the seventh day, I saw a dream by night.
Behold, a strong wind came up from the sea; and all the ships were broken.
That wind, as a man, came forth from the sea; and after this, that man went forth with the clouds of heaven; and when he turned his face to see, all came to him in their time.
And the word, when it went forth, all that arose from the word shall perish; and all who heard the word shall perish like honey that is brought near to the fire.
After this, I saw many people without number coming forth from the sea; they were like men who were gathered from the four corners.
After this, he made a great mountain; and upon it, he sat.
And I wished to know concerning that mountain; however, I could not.
After this, they were afraid of all that were gathered; yet they were like men who were bold.
After this, at the appointed time, when they came to him, his hand was not raised against them; neither did he lift up a sword or any weapon of war.

From his mouth came forth a flame of fire, and from his lips, a burning fire; and from his tongue, a fiery breath as a mighty wind; yet that flame of fire, that burning fire, and that fiery breath all mingled together as a mighty wind.
They were struck down in their pride, and many fell; from their dwelling place and from their stronghold, they were brought low, until none remained among them. After this, I was greatly troubled.
After this, I beheld a man descending from that mountain; many others called to him, saying, "Come to us."

And many people came to him; among them were those who were joyful, and those who were burdened, and those who were captives. After this, when all these things had come upon me, I was greatly troubled and I prayed to the Most High.
Thus I said, "Previously, you showed this authority to your servant; you have done this for me that my prayer might be heard."
Now, reveal to me the interpretation of this vision.
Yet I, as I lamented, was grieved for those who dwell in those days; woe to them! Indeed, woe to those who do not dwell there!
For in the latter days, they will be grieved by that which they do not know.
But for those who have completed their days, it is because they have known.
Therefore, woe to them! In this vision, they will see great distress and much sorrow.
Yet, it would be better not to encounter such tribulation; like a cloud, it would be better to pass from this world; for in the latter days, they will not know what will befall them.

sections.title: The vision of the seer.

verses.text: And he answered me, saying, "I shall declare unto thee the interpretation of this thy dream; and that which thou hast not seen, I shall reveal unto thee."
Concerning those who remain and those who dwell, he hath spoken unto thee, and the interpretation is thus.

In those days, those who shall see that affliction are they who remain; and that affliction shall befall them, yet he himself shall keep them safe in the midst of faith and good deeds, for he is strong.
Nevertheless, know that those who remain in life are more blessed than those who have passed away.
The interpretation of this thy dream is as follows: Behold, this man, as he emerges from the sea.
To preserve the world through him for the age to come, this is what hath been kept. He shall guide those who have been forsaken in accordance with order.
As a swift wind from his mouth, like a flame of fire, shall be seen when the fire is kindled.
He shall not raise the sword or the weapon of war, yet the interpretation is thus: Many shall be destroyed by those who are honored and who have come to slay them.
A time shall come when he shall deliver those who dwell upon the earth.
At that time, they shall be in conflict one with another.
ከተማ ከከተማ ጋር፥ ገጠር ከገጠር ጋር፥ ሕዝብ ከሕዝብ ጋር፥ መንግሥታት ከመንግሥታት ጋር ይዋጋሉ።
ይህም በተደረገ ጊዜ፥ ቀድሞ ያሳየሁህ ምልክቱም በደረሰ ጊዜ ያንጊዜ ከባሕር ሲወጣ ያየኸው ያ ሰው ይገለጣል።
“አሕዛብም ሁሉ ቃሉን በሰሙ ጊዜ ሀገሮቻቸውና እርስ በርሳቸው የሚጣሉበትን ጠባቸውን ይተዋሉ።
ቍጥር የሌላቸው ሰዎች እንዳየሃቸው መጥተው ሊገድሉት ወድደው በአንድነት በዝተው ይሰበሰባሉ።
እርሱ ግን በጽዮን ተራራ ራስ ይቆማል።
ያለ ሰው እጅ የተፈጠረው ተራራ ሲወጣ እንዳየኸው፥ ጽዮን ትመጣለች፤ ተዘጋጅታና ተሠርታም ለሁሉ ትታያለች፤
እንደ ዓውሎ ነፋስ የሆኑ አሕዛብን በኀጢአታቸው የሚዘልፋቸው እርሱ ወልድ ነው። የሥራቸውንም ክፋት በፊታቸው ይገልጥባቸዋል። እንደ እሳት ነበልባል የሆኑትም በጽኑዕ የሚሠቃዩበትን ይገልጣል።
እንደ እሳት ፍም የሆኑትንም ያለ ድካም ከኀጢአታቸው ጋር ያጠፋቸዋል።
“ለእርሱ የሚስማሙ ብዙዎች ወደ እርሱ ሲሰበሰቡ ያየኸውም፥
እኒህ በአሦር ንጉሥ በስልምናሶር ዘመን ካገራቸው የተማረኩ፥ እርሱም በመንግሥቱ የማረካቸው፥ በወንዙ ማዶም ያኖራቸው ዘጠኙ ነገድና የነገድ እኩሌታ ናቸው፤ ተመልሰውም ሌላ ሆኑ።
They shall forsake their kinship and go unto a land where the sons of men dwell not; thus shall they heed this counsel of their own accord.
They shall keep the law which they have not been commanded in their land.
The entrance was guarded, and they entered into the abode of Ephrath.
At that time, He performed great wonders for them; He caused them to stand until they passed the source of the river.
Yet the land shall be forsaken for a year by the spirit; and the name of the land shall be called desolate.
"Until the last age, they shall dwell here; and after this, they shall return again in the time that is not theirs."
They shall be able to dwell, for He shall cause the source of the river to stand still for them.
Therefore, concerning what they have seen, He shall take most of the people from among them. And they shall dwell in my glorious place.
Upon Him, when many were gathered, He shall preserve the remnant of the people that remained when He destroyed them.
At that time, He shall show many signs unto them."
And I said, "O Lord my God, tell me this: Why is it that I saw a man coming forth from the midst of the sea?"

And He said to me: "Just as no man can know what is in the depths of the sea, so likewise no man can know the offspring of the earth; for the time and the day have come, yet those who are with Him do not know."
The interpretation of your vision is this: Therefore, I have shown it to you alone.
You have forsaken your own servant, and you have followed my servant; and you have sought my law.
And I have prepared your life for knowledge; and wisdom has been made manifest to you.
Therefore, I have made this clear to you; your worth is in the highest regard, and indeed, after a few days, there will be another matter concerning you, and I will reveal to you wonders."
In every season, for the wondrous works He performs, let us give thanks to God and honor Him, and I went forth into the wilderness.
He has prepared the seasons; this He will do every year. And there I remained for three days.

sections.title: The Seventh Vision

verses.text: And on the third day, while I sat beneath the tree,
Then a voice came forth from before that tree, saying, "Ezra! Ezra!" And I answered, "Here I am, O Lord," and I arose and stood.
And He said unto me, "I have shown you what I have done for Moses; and when the fathers were sold into Egypt, I spoke unto you beneath the tree which is called 'Paltos.'
And I sent you, and I brought forth the fathers from Egypt; and I sent Moses unto Mount Sinai, and I dwelt with you many days.
I have told you many wondrous things; I have shown you the mysteries of the ages; and I have spoken unto you of the latter days.
Speak of this matter; and I commanded you to speak of this matter as a man.
Now I say unto you:
That which I have spoken unto you, you shall know; and that which you have seen in your dream, and the interpretation of that which you have heard, keep in your heart.
For they shall take you away from man; and after this, until the world shall pass away, you shall dwell in a place where you are with children.
The seasons of the world shall not pass away, for the time has been established.
ዓለም ለዐሥር ክፍል ተከፍሏልና እስከ ዐሥርም ድረስ ደርሷልና።
የዐሥረኛው እኩሌታ ቀርትዋልና።
አሁን ግን ቤትህን አዘጋጅ፤ አዘንተኞቻቸውንም ደስ አሰኛቸው፤ ዐዋቆቻቸውንም ልብ አስደርጋቸው፤ እንግዲህ የምታልፍ ሕይወትንም ተዋት።
መዋቲ አሳብን እንግዲህ ተወው፤ የሰው ሸክምንም ከላይህ ጣል፤ የሚሞት አሳብንም ተው፤ የማይሞተውንም ልበስ፤ እንግዲህም ወዲህ ከዚህ ዓለም ትሸጋገር ዘንድ አፍጥን።
ይች ያየሃት ክፋት ዛሬ ደርሳለችና፤ እንግዲህ ወዲህ ከእርሷ የምትከፋ ዳግመኛ ትደረጋለችና።
ዓለም እያረጀና እየደከመ በሚሄድ መጠን እንዲሁ በውስጡ የሚኖሩ ክፋታቸው ትበዛለችና።
እውነት ትጠፋለችና፥ አሰትም ትጸናለችና። ይህ ያየኸውም ንስር ይደርስ ዘንድ ይቸኵላልና።”
እኔም መለስሁለት፤ እንዲህም አልሁት፥ “እንግዲህስ ወዲህ በፊትህ እናገራለሁ።
አቤቱ፥ እኔ እሄዳለሁና፥ እንደ አዘዝኸኝም ዛሬ ያሉትን ሕዝብ አስተምራቸዋለሁና። እንግዲህ ወዲህ ዳግመኛ የሚወለዱትን ማን ያስተምራቸዋል?
ዓለም በጨለማ ውስጥ አለና፤ በውስጡ ለሚኖሩትም ብርሃን የላቸውም።
"Your origin is hidden, for there is none who knows what You have made, nor what You will make."

"If I have found favor in Your sight, send Your holy Spirit to me; that I may find the way of life, and that those who love to live may be blessed, for I shall write all that has been written in Your origin from ancient times."
"And He answered me, saying, 'Go and gather your people together; speak to them until the fortieth day, that they may not seek you.'"
"But you, prepare much bread, with you shall be Soraya, Derbiya, Selamiya, Ikana, and Asahiel; these five men shall be taken. For they are wise in writing."
"And to this, I will open the light of wisdom in your heart; and all that you have until you finish writing, do not let it perish."
"At your finishing time, there is clarity in what you will do; you will also give to the wise and to the learned; but at this hour, you will begin to write."
"As I was commanded, I went and gathered all the people."
"And thus I said to them, 'O Israel, hear this matter.'"
"Your forefathers dwelt in the land of Egypt; and afterward, they were taken captive."
"And they received the law of life; but they did not keep it; and you, after them, have forsaken it."
We have given the land of inheritance; we have brought low the land of Zion; and you, and your fathers, have not turned away from Him; you have not kept the way of your exalted Lord.
For He is the truth, and in His time, He has given you your portion.
Now you are not in this; but your brethren are separated from you and are within.
That which has troubled your heart, and that which has vexed your mind, as it has been, do not let your life perish.
For after death, judgment shall come; and we shall not be found in life; at that time, the name of the righteous shall be revealed; and the works of the wicked shall be made known.
None shall come to me from among you; until the fortieth day, do not seek me.”
As He commanded me, I took those five men and went into the wilderness; and there we dwelt.
And a word came to me from the Lord, saying, “Ezra! Ezra!” and He said to me, “Open your mouth, and I will give you to drink that which you are to drink.”
And when I opened my mouth, water flowed forth, and the appearance was as a drink that resembles fire.
I received it and drank; and my heart was filled with knowledge; and knowledge was in my heart; and my soul shall keep it; it shall remember it.
My mouth was opened; and then there was silence.

The Most High granted wisdom to those five men; and they wrote all these things, which were signs of that which they did not know, in order to teach; and they remained for forty days; and they wrote day by day; and night by night they were engaged in their work.
But I, I will speak by day; and by night I shall not be silent.
In those forty days, four and twenty books were written.
And after those forty days had passed, the Most High spoke unto me, saying, “Make clear that which ye have written before; let all that is fitting and unfit be read.”
Yet this, keep it for the wise people, that it may be given unto them.
For within these are lights of understanding, a source of wisdom, and a fountain of knowledge.

Thus I did; in the fourth year, in the fifth year of the years of the Sabbaths, after five thousand years from the creation of the world, when the moon was made to shine on the tenth day of the third month, on the twenty-first day.
At that time, after all this was written, the wise men who were like him took it and went to the land where he was; and he was called the Most High, the writer of wisdom, even unto eternity.
